intro: The ten most-played Roblox games this week. Halloween is over, Practical Basketball is in, and Steal a Brainrot drops out.
method: Ranked by player counts on the public tracker Endgametools (snapshot Nov 3, 2026, 02:34 UTC), cross-checked with Livecounts (Nov 3, 11:03 UTC). The two disagree in places: Livecounts had Blox Fruits at No. 2 and did not list Practical Basketball in its top 25.

entries.name: Steal An Egg
entries.note: Still No. 1 by a mile, with about 586,000 players on Nov 3.

entries.name: Murder Mystery 2
entries.note: Back up to No. 2 with about 307,000 players on Nov 3.

entries.name: Brookhaven RP
entries.note: Rock steady at about 302,000 players on Nov 3.

entries.name: Blox Fruits
entries.note: Up five spots; Livecounts even had it at No. 2 later on Nov 3.

entries.name: Adopt Me!
entries.note: Up one, with about 147,000 players on Nov 3.

entries.name: RIVALS
entries.note: Up one, with about 131,000 players on Nov 3.

entries.name: Practical Basketball
entries.note: New: left testing on Oct 30 and hit an all-time peak of about 147,000 players.

entries.name: Jujutsu Shenanigans
entries.note: Up two, with about 99,000 players on Nov 3.

entries.name: Break and Steal an Egg
entries.note: Livecounts showed it up 66.5% in 24 hours on Nov 3.

entries.name: 99 Nights in the Forest
entries.note: Down five, with about 93,000 players on Nov 3.
